documents.title: Civil Service Pension Scheme: £25–40m profit hit in 2026
documents.source_ref: Capita trading & CSPS contract update — 9 July 2026
documents.excerpt: Surge resourcing, remediation and KPI-related costs on the CSPS contract are expected to reduce 2026 adjusted operating profit by £25m–£40m, with a £35m–£50m free cash flow impact.

documents.title: Continuing revenue up 1.6% to £906.4m in H1
documents.excerpt: Public Service grew 2.4% and Pension Solutions 24.7%, offsetting the planned Regulated Services exit. Adjusted operating margin fell to 3.6% from 5.3% on CSPS costs.

documents.title: £40m simplification savings — £8m actioned
documents.excerpt: After the private sector contact centre disposal, actions taken by 30 June deliver £8m of annualised savings against a £40m target by end-2027, with about £20m cost to achieve.

documents.title: £24.4bn pipeline, £998m H1 TCV
documents.excerpt: Book-to-bill of 1.1x and the strongest Public Service TCV since 2021, including Synergy Business Process Services (from summer 2027) and a £425m TfL renewal signed in July.

documents.title: Snowflake chosen as the data layer of the AI Catalyst Stack
documents.excerpt: Capita agreed a multi-year deal with Snowflake for the data management and intelligence layer and reached Snowflake Select Partner status, alongside its AWS Marketplace BPO storefront.
